    MT HUTT

    3 chairlifts · 683 m vertical · 365 ha
    Terrain reconstructed from the LINZ national 8 m elevation model; runs and lifts from OpenStreetMap, named and graded as on the Mt Hutt 2026 trail map. Winter surface from a Sentinel-2 satellite scene (July–September 2025), with fine detail from 0.2 m aerial photography and relief shading computed from the elevation model. Lines drawn from the trail map rather than surveyed are marked estimated.
